interface.title: AstroClassify — SDSS Astronomical Object Classification Dashboard
interface.field: Astronomy / astrophysics (photometric source classification, machine learning)
interface.stage_of_work: Interpretation and sanity-checking of individual sources; exploratory what-if analysis of a trained classifier
interface.what_it_is_for: Enter or sample SDSS ugriz magnitudes and redshift for one object, get a Random Forest prediction (STAR, GALAXY or QSO) with a confidence value, and check it against the object's spectral energy distribution and its place on color-color diagrams of a reference SDSS catalog.

data.note: The sidebar starts with a QSO-like SDSS record (u=21.8858, g=21.0019, r=20.8359, i=20.7851, z=20.6269, redshift=2.435862). 'Load Random Observation' fills all six inputs from a bundled sample of SDSS records, but it does not show the record's catalog class. The color-color diagram draws the reference catalog as points colored STAR/QSO/GALAXY. There is no upload. The only download is the Plotly PNG export (plot-image.png). On first load the model takes several seconds to load ('Running load_stellar_model()', screens/003.webp).

tree.specific: Classify an SDSS source as STAR, GALAXY or QSO from u, g, r, i, z magnitudes and redshift with the Random Forest, then check it on the SED and color-color diagrams

features.name: Live single-object classifier with confidence card
features.general: Enter the measured features of one item in a form and see the model's predicted category and confidence update at once, color-coded by category
features.specific: Six number inputs (u, g, r, i, z magnitudes, Cosmological Redshift) with +/- steppers feed a Random Forest. The card shows STAR/GALAXY/QSO and Model Confidence (the top class's probability only) in that class's color
steps: Type a value or press +/- on any band or redshift input
Read the predicted class and confidence on the card
Repeat with other values to see when the class flips or the confidence drops
serves_tasks: Read the predicted category and its confidence
Change the distance-like input and see the category flip
Change one band's brightness and see how confidence moves
Flag a confident prediction that falls outside every reference population

features.name: Random real-record loader for testing the model
features.general: Fill the input form with a randomly drawn real record from a reference dataset and run the model on it, to see how it behaves on real examples. The record's true label is not shown
features.specific: 'Load Random Observation' overwrites all six sidebar inputs with one record from the bundled SDSS sample, and the prediction, SED and color-color marker all update. Only u, g, r, i, z and redshift are copied; the record's catalog class is not displayed
steps: See the sidebar inputs replaced with the record's values
Read the new prediction and plots
serves_tasks: Test the trained model on real catalogued objects drawn at random

features.name: Band-selectable SED line plot
features.general: Plot one item's value across ordered channels and choose which channels to include with a multi-select that has select all and clear all
features.specific: Spectral Energy Distribution: apparent magnitude (inverted axis) over u, g, r, i, z, colored by predicted class. The Filter Selection chips remove or add bands, with Select all and Clear all. Hover shows (band, magnitude)
steps: Remove a band with its chip ×
Add bands back from the dropdown or with Select all (plotted in wavelength order)
Clear all to empty the plot
Hover a point to read its exact magnitude
Drag to pan and double-click to reset
serves_tasks: Look at the object's brightness across wavelength bands

features.name: Color-color diagram with query-object overlay, selectable axes and class filtering
features.general: Scatter a labeled reference population on two derived indices you choose, with the current item drawn as a distinct marker, and hide or isolate groups to see which one it falls in or whether it is an outlier
features.specific: Color-Color Diagram: X and Y dropdowns pick from u-g, g-r, r-i, i-z (the Y list leaves out the current X choice). SDSS catalog points are colored STAR/QSO/GALAXY, and a white × marks the Selected Source and moves when the inputs change. Clicking a class's legend marker hides it and double-clicking isolates it. Box zoom and hover (class and both indices) help find the × in crowded regions
steps: Find the Selected Source × relative to the class clouds
Edit a magnitude or load a new record and watch the × move
Click a class's legend marker to hide it, or double-click to isolate it and again to restore all
Box-zoom into the overlap and hover points to read class and coordinates, then Reset axes
serves_tasks: Place the object on a two-index diagram against labeled reference populations
Flag a confident prediction that falls outside every reference population
Narrow the reference populations and zoom in to see where they overlap

screens_never_reached: A per-class confidence breakdown (probabilities for STAR, GALAXY and QSO side by side): the README promises per-class confidence scores, but the card only ever showed the winning class's percentage

The catalog (true) class of a randomly loaded record: the README presents random sampling as a way to check the model on unseen real-world examples, but only u, g, r, i, z and redshift are copied into the inputs, so prediction and truth cannot be compared in the interface
A collapsed-sidebar layout: the 'Collapse sidebar' button (<<) did not respond to a coordinate click, and the ref click timed out (screens/042.webp, screens/043.webp)
not_done: Judging reliability from all three per-class scores: the interface shows only the top-class confidence. Reliability could only be judged from that single value (e.g. 84% vs 100%) and from where the source sits on the color-color diagram
Checking a random record's prediction against its true class: the class is not shown in the interface
Fullscreen, zoom in/out and autoscale buttons in the Plotly toolbars were not tried one by one; reset by double-click and Reset axes were
The SED chart's box-zoom mode was not tried: a drag on it panned, because pan is its default mode (screens/041.webp)
Reading the SED shape for class clues (e.g. UV excess or a break) was not done as a step; the SED was only used to exercise band selection and hover
The downloaded plot-image.png was not opened by the explorer (it is binary), only confirmed by the download list and the success toast
Browsing or choosing a specific record in the bundled sample: records can only be drawn at random
A click on a legend label's text (rather than its marker) did not hide the class in the replay
